objective.title: Qualify provider-neutral composition results and matrix capability contracts

declared.summary: Activate M2-W02, introduce the independent versioned composition package, qualify exact/approximate/unsupported/budget result states, bound matrix inspection and provenance, and execute a controlled behavioral RED followed by seven GREEN tests and package/regression checks.
declared.value: Typed provider-neutral composition API consumers can inspect numeric shape and result completeness without executing providers, inventing results, widening exact values or mistaking capability discovery for authorization.
debtChanges: M2-W02-C01-T2 remains planned: independent provider-visibility, authorization, no-result boundary and integration oracles must be qualified before C01 closure.
The new matrix capability describes admitted shape and precision only; it is not execution, AURA authority, scheduling or provider admission.
ComputationStatus labels supplied outcomes without an algorithm or provenance of actual execution; result factories validate type and presence but never calculate results.
New composition and test packages use locked NuGet dependencies and are packaged locally; no external publishing or repository modification is claimed.
RS032 retry 0 failed pre-attempt controlled-progress: M2-W02 and M2-W02-C01 were activated, not done. Retry 1 removes only these two achievement claims; T1's four done nodes and scope remain intact.
declared.nextAction: Qualify M2-W02-C01-T2 with adversarial permission-independent discoverability, explicit absence of final results and public assembly surface tests; then close C01 only after T2 RED/GREEN and integration checks.

achievements.achievement: A controlled RED observes failure when matrix inspection wrongly advertises scalar input, preserving a behavioral falsification test.
A standalone provider-neutral .NET composition package offers typed exact/approximate and missing-result statuses, matrix shape/capability inspection, and bounded versioned provenance.
Seven independent behavioral tests pass after RED, with full locked build, IR/foundation regressions, architecture check and qualified local NuGet package.
Result-and-capability contract completes without implying generic computation, provider admission, AURA permission or external adoption.
